course_details.Overview of class:
This course teaches students clear, concise and coherent writing - the same basics taught at the Medill School of Journalism, Media, Integrated Marketing Communications. Writing for Media encourages and instructs in the appropriate and ethical use of artificial intelligence as part of the writing exercises. Assignments start in class and continue with rewriting until the next session. The instructor remains available for coaching and feedback all week long. Students gain confidence and demonstrate improvement in written expression each week. The skills acquired in Writing for Media provide a solid foundation for future course work at Northwestern University as well as in professional settings.

Schedule note: this course will meet remotely, with weekly remote synchronous sessions held on the scheduled day.
